blinding_guess.why: COMMAND_LONG.confirmation is used as a 'require ACK' flag: arming/set_home/takeoff/land/trigger_control send confirmation=1 on the first (and only) transmission and is_ack_required keys on confirmation != 0, whereas the field is meant to count retransmissions (0 on first send); COMMAND_INT is sent without waiting for COMMAND_ACK on the stated assumption that it produces none; ACK matching uses only ack.command.

notes: All seven elements are MAVLink (mavlink::common dialect) messages/fields carried over libmavconn to the FCU, not ROS topics; QoS, rate_hz and min_rate_hz are therefore null (ROS 1 and none set). The MAVLink definitions of COMMAND_LONG, COMMAND_INT, COMMAND_ACK and HEARTBEAT live in the external mavlink package (message_definitions XML, pulled in via find_package(mavlink) in libmavconn/cmake/Modules/MavrosMavlink.cmake; dependencies.rosinstall points at mavlink-gbp-release release/kinetic/mavlink). They are not in the snapshot, are not an allowed definition-file type (.msg/.srv/.action/.idl), and ros_distro is null, so no definition_id could be computed (all null). For the same reason the three provided elements (msg:mavlink/COMMAND_INT, msg:mavlink/COMMAND_LONG, field:mavlink/COMMAND_LONG.confirmation) could not be rendered in the declares templates (hash / field type as written in the definition are unavailable); they are in neither declares nor not_declared, although the code positively constructs and sends COMMAND_LONG (command.cpp:240-253) and COMMAND_INT (command.cpp:271-286) and writes cmd.confirmation (command.cpp:244). The code passes confirmation as uint8_t (command.cpp:135/226/238) and the ROS-side service field is 'uint8 confirmation' (mavros_msgs/srv/CommandLong.srv:6); this is not the MAVLink definition and was not used as the field type. Confirmation values sent: from the cmd/command service request (req.confirmation), forced to 0 when broadcast (command.cpp:238); hard-coded 1 for arming (320), set_home (331), takeoff (342), land (355), trigger_control (367); sys_status sets confirmation=false for REQUEST_AUTOPILOT_CAPABILITIES (sys_status.cpp:744); mavcmd -c/--confirmation maps a boolean to 0/1 (scripts/mavcmd:34,205). is_ack_required = confirmation != 0 || is_ardupilotmega() || is_px4() (command.cpp:158), where the autopilot type comes from the FCU HEARTBEAT.autopilot field (sys_status.cpp:629 -> uas_data.cpp:47 -> mavros_uas.h:283-292). mavros also sends its own HEARTBEAT with autopilot = MAV_AUTOPILOT::INVALID (sys_status.cpp:720); the packet lists HEARTBEAT.autopilot only as consumed, so that is noted here only. HEARTBEAT liveness: conn/timeout default 30.0 s (sys_status.cpp:419), 10.0 in launch/px4_config.yaml:11; not recorded as min_rate_hz because it is a timeout, not a declared rate. COMMAND_LONG frame left null: params 5-7 carry lat/lon/alt for set_home/takeoff/land but no frame is declared in code. references restricted to the packet's consumed elements; the code also references other MAVLink messages (e.g. msg:mavlink/HEARTBEAT) not listed here. The ROS services that feed these messages are ~cmd/command, ~cmd/command_int, ~cmd/arming, ~cmd/set_home, ~cmd/takeoff, ~cmd/land, ~cmd/trigger_control (command.cpp:68-74).
